terminals.name: main-app
terminals.description: SignalFold FastAPI monolith — REST API (/api/*) + vanilla-JS SPA on http://127.0.0.1:8000. Runs the R proteomics pipeline in a background thread.

terminals.name: ai-sidecar
terminals.description: AI Insights v2 Node/Pi sidecar on http://127.0.0.1:4317 (UI + /operations). Live AI answers need a provider key in ai-sidecar/.env; Deep Research free-form execution additionally needs Docker.
